title: Qt: qsizetype fixups.
description:
Qt 6 added qsizetype. Add a typedef for Qt 5 compatibility and use it
where we can. Cast to int where we can't.

commits_data.title: Qt: Handle qsizetype.
commits_data.message:
Qt: Handle qsizetype.

Qt 5.10 added qsizetype, aka an ssize_t and Qt 6 makes extensive use of
it. Add a compatibility typedef and use it where we can. Cast it away
where we can't.
